title: Ad-Duha 93:5-8 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Ash-Sharh, Ad-Duha 1 to 8 and applying the rules
source: Written for quran/y3 lesson 38 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ad-Duha 93:5-8 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 38. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ (٥) أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًۭا فَـَٔاوَىٰ (٦) وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّۭا فَهَدَىٰ (٧) وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًۭا فَأَغْنَىٰ (٨)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
And He found you lost and guided [you],
And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.

keywords.def: a madd held for six counts before a shaddah or sukoon

questions.q: Chunk and link Ad-Duha 93:5-8 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 93:5-8 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 93:5-8 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Recite Ad-Duha 1 to 8 to a partner.
Name the three gifts in 93:6 to 8.
questions.a: Shelter for the orphan, guidance, and being made self-sufficient.

questions.q: What did Allah do when the Prophet ﷺ was an orphan (93:6)?
questions.a: A) Gave him shelter. 93:6: 'Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?'

questions.q: Ad-Duha 93:6: «أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Allah reminds the Prophet ﷺ that he was an orphan and Allah gave him shelter. How does that teach us to treat orphans?
questions.a: With kindness and care, never harshly, as the next ayat of Ad-Duha teach.
